camera_vault_coverage_alerts.body: WITH stats AS ( SELECT COUNT(*)::INT AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE dek_wrapped IS NOT NULL)::INT AS enveloped, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE encrypted_password IS NOT NULL AND dek_wrapped IS NULL)::INT AS legacy, MIN(wrapped_at) FILTER (WHERE dek_wrapped IS NOT NULL) AS oldest_wrap FROM public.camera_credentials ) SELECT total, enveloped, legacy, oldest_wrap, CASE WHEN legacy = 0 THEN 'ok' WHEN legacy > 0 AND (oldest_wrap IS NULL OR now() - oldest_wrap > INTERVAL '24 hours') THEN 'critical' ELSE 'warn' END AS severity FROM stats

Parser SDP robusto para extração de codec, resolução e fps. Trabalha exclusivamente sobre a seção `m=video` e agrega várias fontes possíveis (rtpmap, fmtp, a=framerate, a=x-framerate, a=cliprect, a=x-dimensions, a=framesize, sprop-parameter-sets/H.264 SPS).
